gateError.GATE_INSP_PHOTO_TYPE: Photo refused: type “{{mime}}” is not accepted (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).
gateError.GATE_INSP_PHOTO_EMPTY: Photo refused: the file is empty.
gateError.GATE_INSP_PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: Photo refused: it is larger than {{mb}} MB.
gateError.GATE_INSP_FILE_NAME_INVALID: File refused: the file name is not valid.
gateError.GATE_INSP_ROUND_EVIDENCE_CLOSED: Evidence refused: the round is « $t(inspections:status.{{status}}) », no more evidence can be added.
gateError.GATE_INSP_ROUND_INCOMPLETE: Completion refused: some checks have no answer or evidence is missing.

scope.SCOPE_OUTSIDE_SITE: This record belongs to a site outside your roles.
scope.SCOPE_RECORD_WITHOUT_SITE: This record has no site: only a plant-wide role can act on it.
scope.SCOPE_PLANT_WIDE_ONLY: This is a plant-wide object: only a plant-wide role can act on it.
scope.SCOPE_ADMIN_ROLE_PLANT_WIDE: Administrator roles are plant-wide: they cannot be limited to a site.
scope.PERMIT_HANDOVER_NO_RECEIVER_AT_SITE: Nobody at this site holds the permit close right: no one can receive this hand-over. Ask an administrator to give the right at this site.
scope.PERMIT_HANDOVER_RECEIVER_NO_RIGHT: The receiving person does not hold the permit close right at this permit's site.
scope.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_LOCKED: This permit was approved for this equipment. Cancel it and raise a new permit.
scope.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_LOCK_FITTED: A lock is fitted under this permit and its removal has not been verified: its equipment cannot be changed. Cancel the permit, have the lock removal verified, then raise a new permit.
scope.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_ISOLATIONS_PLANNED: Isolation points are planned on this permit for its current equipment: its equipment cannot be changed. Cancel the planned isolation lines, or cancel the permit and raise a new one for the new equipment.
scope.PERMIT_SITE_NOT_EQUIPMENT_SITE: A permit is recorded at the site of its equipment (or of its work order), or at a level above it: another site, or a level below, cannot be given.
scope.PERMIT_SITE_LOCKED: This permit was approved at this site: its site can no longer change. Cancel it and raise a new permit.
scope.PERMIT_WO_EQUIPMENT_MISMATCH: The permit's equipment must be the equipment of its work order.
scope.DI_ORG_NODE_REQUIRED: A request must be attached to a site: choose equipment installed on an org node.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason (at least {{min}} characters) for the site you give.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_NO_RECORDS: Select the records to give a site to.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_TOO_MANY: At most {{max}} records can be given a site at once.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_ALREADY_HAS_SITE: These records already have a site, which cannot be changed here: {{records}}. Reload the list.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_NODE_INVALID: The site chosen is not a unit of the published organisation (deleted, or still in a draft).
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: These records were already given a site once, which is kept for good: they cannot be given one again here ({{records}}). A planner gives a planning window its site again in the window dialog.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_PERMANENT_RIGHT_REQUIRED: Giving a site to a record without one needs the organisation administration right for the whole plant through a permanent role: an emergency grant is not enough.
scope.SITE_ASSIGN_REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason has at most {{max}} characters.
